record.original_title: Zakon o izvajanju uredbe (EU) o določitvi harmoniziranih pravil o umetni inteligenci (ZIUDHPUI)
record.summary: Slovenia's law implementing the EU AI Act. Notifying authorities are the ministries for the market, infrastructure, health and the information society and the medicines agency. AKOS supervises Annex I Section A products, Annex III points 2, 4, 5(a) and 5(d) and Article 50, and is single point of contact, sandbox operator, keeper of a register of high-risk AI in critical infrastructure and SME entry point; the Information Commissioner supervises the Article 5 prohibitions and Annex III points 1, 3 and 6 to 8; sector supervisors cover credit and insurance. Public bodies must publish data on the AI they use. A National Council for Ethics in AI is created; fines reach EUR 35 million or 7%.
record.notes: Adopted by the National Assembly on 23 October 2025, promulgated on 31 October 2025 and published in Uradni list RS 85/2025 on 6 November 2025; in force on the fifteenth day after publication (Article 45), i.e. 21 November 2025. Articles 25-35 set misdemeanour fines by tier (EUR 35 million or 7% for prohibited practices, EUR 15 million or 3% for operator obligations, EUR 7.5 million or 1% for incorrect or misleading information, EUR 500-5,000 for public bodies that fail to publish AI system information). The publication duty (Article 21) does not apply to AI used in law enforcement, defence, national security, migration, asylum and border control. AKOS had to set up the first regulatory sandbox by 2 August 2026 (Article 40). Conformity assessment bodies are assessed by the national accreditation service (Article 5). The national AI strategy of March 2026 (NsUI 2030) treats the act as the legal basis of its 'ethics and regulation' measures.

verification.note: Stored: the Official Gazette HTML text of the act (Uradni list RS 85/2025, item 3035), with the promulgation decree and Articles 1-45; the gazette PDF of issue 85/2025; and the Government's news release of 24 October 2025 on the adoption. The gazette text confirms the title, abbreviation, adoption, promulgation and publication dates, the entry-into-force clause and every provision summarised here. The news release names the Ministry of Digital Transformation as the responsible ministry. Not confirmed by any stored copy: a public consultation on the draft in March 2025 (taken from the title of a gov.si news item), the Commission's list of 7 September 2026 showing AKOS for Slovenia with the designation pending, and the treatment of the act in NsUI 2030, which rests on the SI-02 record.

judgment.status_reasoning: Article 45: the act enters into force on the fifteenth day after publication in the Official Gazette; it was published in Uradni list RS 85/2025 of 6 November 2025, so it entered into force on 21 November 2025, before today (14 October 2026). No stored source shows an amendment or repeal: In force.
judgment.scope_reasoning: National law implementing the EU AI Act (EU-03); clearly in scope.

changes.original_title: made verbatim: the gazette writes 'uredbe' in lower case in the title; only the Government release capitalises it
changes.summary: corrected the allocation of supervision (Article 10): AKOS supervises Annex I Section A, Annex III points 2, 4, 5(a) and 5(d) and Article 50, not 'most Annex I and III areas'; the Information Commissioner supervises Article 5 and Annex III points 1, 3 and 6 to 8, not only the prohibitions; 'ministry for trade' rendered literally as the ministry responsible for the market ('ministrstvo, pristojno za trg', Article 3(1)); the accreditation body moved to notes because the act names the function, not 'Slovenian Accreditation'; added the public-sector publication duty (Article 21)
changes.notes: removed the duplicate adoption sentence; added the prohibited-practice fine tier, the exemptions from the publication duty, the sandbox deadline and the accreditation function; the March 2025 consultation and the Commission list, which rest on pages that are not stored, moved to verification.note
changes.verification.note: rewritten to describe the stored copies
